# Telegram Mini App SDK

Unmodified snapshot downloaded from the official endpoint
https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js on 2026-09-27.
SHA256: 3549138a7934039fe7dfd1291a4ee739bd2b705a614308053a8b08a87d85c451.

Served from our own origin so split-tunnel VPN clients do not need a separate
successful connection to telegram.org just to initialize the app. No bot token
or user launch data is bundled. Update deliberately from the official source;
change the version query in index.html and rerun launch tests.
